criteria.criterion: A regression test drives a tracker into `push_state` pending, brings HEAD level with `origin/tickets`, and asserts `store_freshness` returns verdict `fresh`, added to `pytest tests/unit/test_gate_store_freshness.py`.

citation.description: Ticket comment (timestamp 1789872516064255644) records 4 failing tests on baseline main including `test_a_level_store_reconciles_a_stale_push_pending_marker`, with failure text showing `{'fresh': False, 'verdict': 'push-pending', ...}`. Test docstring at line 183-187 also explicitly references the baseline behavior.

criteria.criterion: That same test is recorded failing on baseline `main`, with the `stale-store` verdict quoted on this ticket.
A clone genuinely AHEAD of `origin/tickets` with the sentinel set still reports `push-pending`, asserted by its own test so the fix cannot whitewash undelivered events.
A level store whose marker records the commit-leg reason `commit-failed` also reports `fresh`, asserted by its own test.

The existing cases in `pytest tests/unit/test_gate_store_freshness.py` pass unchanged, covering behind via `test_a_store_behind_the_shared_store_is_stale`, diverged via `test_a_diverged_store_is_stale`, and fail-open via `test_the_probe_fails_OPEN_on_its_own_error`.
After one level-store probe, a second `push_state.read_status` call reports state `ok`, asserted in the same test.
When `push_state.clear` cannot remove the marker, the probe still returns `fresh`, asserted by its own test.
